about: Tax agreements. For each host country (where the companies stand): the partner countries whose citizens' companies are covered, and which of the host's regions each agreement covers: "all", "core" (the host's own original regions, not conquered ones) or a list of region names. The host sends the partner pay_percent (default 90) of the employee and manager income tax generated by those companies. Only these companies are collected. Edited from the Streamlit Settings page.
